/effect.reason: Weapon-keyword mechanics are community-authored Ability DSL entries; MFM ability rules remain prose and are not copied into this field.

/game_version.reason: The catalog version reference is repository-authored metadata, not a property of an MFM wargear ability.

/game_version/dataslate.reason: The catalog dataslate reference is repository-authored version metadata.

/game_version/edition.reason: The catalog edition reference is repository-authored version metadata.

transforms.operation: Parse recognized localized ability names into existing canonical keyword reference ids and reference-site parameters.

filters: Use English localized ability names reached from each wargear-item profile.
Retain only ability names recognized by the closed mapper.
precedence: Repository-authored keyword catalog ids remain authoritative; the dump only supplies observed references.
An unrecognized ability name produces a warning and no keyword reference.
/id.reason: The static catalog owns canonical ids, while the supported profile-to-ability graph determines which existing ids are referenced by projected weapon profiles.

/name.reason: Canonical catalog display names are repository-authored; localized MFM ability labels are only parser input for weapon-profile references.

/required_parameters.reason: Required parameter contracts are repository-authored catalog semantics; the parser extracts values only for already-defined keyword references.

/required_parameters/*.reason: Each parameter-key definition is repository-authored catalog semantics rather than an MFM field.

unmapped_mfm_fields.reason: Ability names outside mapWeaponKeyword's closed mapping are deliberately retained only as project-loadout warnings and do not mint a weapon-keyword catalog entry.
